description: HP lt4132: a Huawei ME906s-158 (LTE Cat.6 M.2) under HP's VID 03f0:a31d, so the generic huawei profile (VID 12d1) does not see it. The kernel's option driver takes its vendor-class ttys by Huawei interface protocol (class ff, subclass 06, protocols 10/12/13/14/1b), not by number, so no AT interface is hinted. ModemManager's Huawei plugin only takes VID 12d1: this identity gets the generic plugin, which cannot dial with AT^NDISDUP; prefer its MBIM function. Radio over AT is still the Huawei dialect (AT^SYSCFGEX, AT^HCSQ)

radio.source: Linux 6.12 drivers/usb/serial/option.c (HP lt4132 = Huawei ME906s-158, 03f0:a31d); ModemManager 1.25.95 src/plugins/huawei/mm-plugin-huawei.c (vendor IDs 12d1 only); another modem manager 3.5.5 reads 03f0:a31d with its Huawei 12d1:1506 profile (AT^HCSQ, AT^SYSCFGEX)
